title: UEFA CEDB (JSA) - 24 & 29.04.2026
text:
CONTROL, ETHICS AND DISCIPLINARY BODY - JUDGE SITTING ALONE 

Decisions of 24 and 29 April 2026

 
 
 
 
 CEDB – 24 and 29 April 2026 

Dear Sir or Madam, 

Please  see  below  the  main  elements  of  the  decisions  taken  by  a  judge  sitting  alone  (JSA)  of  the  UEFA 
Control, Ethics and Disciplinary Body (CEDB) on 24 and 29 April 2026. 

If, following a request by the party concerned, a decision with grounds is issued, that full decision will be 
made available in the case law section of this website after it becomes final and binding. 

To navigate this document, you can click on the name of a case in the contents to jump to that particular 
sanction and click on the header at the top of any page to return to the contents.  

We trust this document will be of interest.  

Yours faithfully, 

UEFA 

Angelo Rigopoulos  
Executive Director of Integrity & Regulatory  

William McAuliffe 
Head of Disciplinary
